title: Architect Toolkit
description: Published TypeScript library of reusable design patterns and typed domain errors
longDescription: An npm package (@codismart/architect-toolkit) that packages the patterns worth not rewriting per project: Builder, Step, State, Repository, Command and Specification, plus Cassandra and MongoDB adapters, a typed hierarchy of domain errors (network, database, validation) and naming-convention converters between camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case.

keyFeatures.title: Patterns as installable code
keyFeatures.description: Builder, Step, State, Repository, Command and Specification implementations published to npm, so they stop being copy-pasted between projects.

keyFeatures.title: A typed hierarchy of domain errors
keyFeatures.description: Distinct error types for network, database and validation failures, so a caller can branch on the failure kind instead of parsing messages.

keyFeatures.title: Storage adapters included
keyFeatures.description: Modules for working with MongoDB and Cassandra alongside the pattern implementations.

keyFeatures.title: Naming-convention converters
keyFeatures.description: Conversion between camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case — the boundary chore every integration hits.
